messages.subject: Error Predicting Scores
parts:
Hello,

I want to calculate the scores for my SEM model, but whenever I run predict(fit) I get the following error although the model itself seems fine:

Error in LAMBDA %*% EETA : non-conformable arguments

What can I do to fix this problem?

Thank you,
Deut

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error Predicting Scores
parts:
On 05/28/2014 05:25 PM, Deuterium wrote:
> Hello,
>
> I want to calculate the scores for my SEM model, but whenever I run
> predict(fit) I get the following error although the model itself seems fine:
>
> Error in LAMBDA %*% EETA : non-conformable arguments

This is a (known) bug of lavaan 0.5-16. Will be fixed ASAP. It does work
with 0.5-15.

It only happens if you have exogenous covariates in your model.

Yves.

messages.author: 89c9fc822e34b78c
messages.subject: Re: Error Predicting Scores
parts:
On 06/04/2014 07:31 AM, Deuterium wrote:
> Oh okay thanks! However, how can I downgrade from 0.5-16 to 0.5-15?

Go to

http://cran.r-project.org/src/contrib/Archive/lavaan/

and download 'lavaan_0.5-15.tar.gz' in a temp directory (under windows,
this is typically c:\temp while under linux, this would be /tmp).

Then, you can install the package by typing eg:

install.packages("c:/temp/lavaan_0.5-15.tar.gz", repos=NULL, type="source")

(you may need to change the path, so that it points to the *.tar.gz file
on your system).

Yves.
